# Global flags

Every tfcensus command accepts these flags, before or after the command name. `-h, --help` prints the help of any command.

| Flag | Description | Type | Default | Values | Config key | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--color` | colorize output: auto, always or never | string | `auto` | `auto`: color on a terminal unless NO\_COLOR is set<br>`always`: always color<br>`never`: never color |  |  |
| `--config` | config file to use instead of the discovered .tfcensus.yaml (env TFCENSUS\_CONFIG) | string |  |  |  |  |
| `--format` | output format: tty, plain, md, json, csv, sarif or github (default tty when stdout is a terminal, else plain) | string |  | `tty`: table with color for a terminal<br>`plain`: table without color<br>`md`: Markdown<br>`json`: JSON envelope for scripts<br>`csv`: comma-separated values<br>`sarif`: SARIF 2.1.0 for code scanning<br>`github`: GitHub Actions annotations |  |  |
| `--log-file` | write logs to this file instead of stderr | string |  |  |  |  |
| `--log-format` | log format: text or json | string | `text` | `text`: human-readable lines<br>`json`: one JSON object per line |  |  |
| `--no-input` | never prompt for input | bool |  |  |  |  |
| `-q, --quiet` | log errors only | bool |  |  |  | not with `--verbose` |
| `--tf-path` | terraform or tofu binary, passed to terragrunt as --tf-path (config binaries.terraform) | string | `terraform` |  | [`binaries.terraform`](/reference/config#binaries-terraform) |  |
| `--tg-path` | terragrunt binary (config binaries.terragrunt) | string | `terragrunt` |  | [`binaries.terragrunt`](/reference/config#binaries-terragrunt) |  |
| `--tofu-path` | tofu binary that --decrypt-with-tofu runs (config binaries.tofu) | string | `tofu` |  | [`binaries.tofu`](/reference/config#binaries-tofu) |  |
| `-v, --verbose` | more logging: -v info, -vv debug, -vvv trace | count |  |  |  | not with `--quiet` |

Each command page lists the `--format` values that command accepts.
